landing.heroTitle: Turn your WhatsApp messages and voice notes into automatic financial organization.
landing.heroSubtitle: As you saw in the video: snap a photo of the receipt or send a quick voice note. Our Artificial Intelligence reads, categorizes and organizes everything without you opening spreadsheets.
landing.faqSubtitle: Get your questions about NotaZip answered
landing.faq1_a: Yes! The free plan allows up to 12 daily WhatsApp messages. For more features, we have affordable plans.
landing.faq2_q: How does sending notes via WhatsApp work?
landing.faq2_a: After connecting your WhatsApp in settings, just send a photo of the receipt or describe the expense by message. Our AI automatically extracts the data.
landing.faq3_a: Yes. We use asymmetric encryption and a Zero-Knowledge architecture, so not even our team can read your receipts or financial data.
landing.faq4_a: Yes! You can export reports as CSV, PDF and image directly from the reports page.
landing.faq5_q: How do I upgrade my plan?
landing.faq5_a: Visit the plans page in the app and choose the plan that best suits your needs. The change is instant.
landing.faq6_q: Can I cancel at any time?
landing.faq6_a: Yes, you can cancel or downgrade your plan at any time, with no penalty or commitment.
landing.testimonialsSubtitle: Thousands of people already use NotaZip to organize their finances
landing.testimonial1_content: My wife and I finally stopped arguing about bills. We send expenses to Nota Zip on WhatsApp, and the system consolidates the household account in one place.
landing.testimonial2_content: I hate filling out spreadsheets. Now I just send a voice note leaving the café: 'Spent 15 reais on espresso', and the bot already records it in my budget.
landing.testimonial3_content: Simple and intuitive. The free plan already perfectly meets my needs to control my daily expenses.
landing.footerDescription: Manage your finances in a simple and smart way, directly through WhatsApp.
landing.howItWorksStep1: Send a photo, voice note or text via WhatsApp
landing.howItWorksStep3: See everything organized in the dashboard
landing.securityDescription: We are developers focused on security. Nota Zip was designed so that not even the creators of the system can read your financial data or view your receipts. You are 100% in control.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_text: This Privacy Policy describes how NotaZip collects, uses, stores and protects your personal data, in compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD - Law No. 13.709/2018).
privacy.s2_item1: Registration data: name, email, password (stored with cryptographic hash)
privacy.s2_item2: Financial data: transactions, categories, values, dates, submitted receipts
privacy.s2_item3: Usage data: access logs, configuration preferences
privacy.s2_item4: Communication data: messages sent via WhatsApp for processing
privacy.s3_item2: Process receipts via OCR and AI
privacy.s3_item4: Communicate about the service and updates
privacy.s4_text: Personal data processing is based on the data subject's consent (Art. 7º, I of LGPD) and contract performance (Art. 7º, V of LGPD). By creating an account, you consent to data processing as described in this policy.
privacy.s5_text: We do not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. Your data may only be shared with: infrastructure providers (hosting, database) under confidentiality agreements; legal authorities when required by law or court order.
privacy.s6_text: Your data is stored on secure servers with encryption in transit (TLS/SSL). Passwords are stored with bcrypt hash. We implement strict access controls and continuous monitoring. Data is retained while your account is active or as necessary to meet legal obligations.
privacy.s7_intro: Under LGPD, you have the right to:
privacy.s7_item1: Access: request a copy of your personal data
privacy.s7_item2: Correction: request correction of incomplete or incorrect data
privacy.s7_item3: Deletion: request deletion of your personal data
privacy.s7_item4: Portability: request transfer of your data to another service
privacy.s7_item5: Revocation: revoke consent for data processing
privacy.s7_item6: Information: be informed about data sharing
privacy.s7_contact: To exercise these rights, contact us by email: privacidade@notazip.com.br
privacy.s8_text: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep your session active, store configuration preferences and improve user experience. You can configure your browser to refuse cookies, but this may affect service functionality.
privacy.s9_text: This policy may be updated periodically. Significant changes will be communicated by email or in-app notification. We recommend reviewing this policy regularly.
privacy.s10_text: For questions related to personal data protection, contact our Data Protection Officer by email: dpo@notazip.com.br

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.s1_text: By accessing and using NotaZip, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should not use our services.
terms.s2_text: NotaZip is a personal financial management platform that allows recording, categorization and analysis of expenses and income. The service includes WhatsApp integration for sending receipts and vouchers, OCR and artificial intelligence processing, and financial report generation.
terms.s3_text: To use NotaZip, you must create an account providing true and updated information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and for all activities performed in your account.
terms.s4_text: NotaZip offers free and paid plans. Paid plans are charged as described on the plans page. Cancellation can be made at any time, without penalty or commitment. There is no prorated refund for unused period.
terms.s5_text: You agree to use NotaZip only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms. It is prohibited to: use the service for illegal activities; attempt to access other users' accounts; send malicious content; intentionally overload our servers; resell or redistribute the service without authorization.
terms.s6_text: All NotaZip content, including brand, design, source code and documentation, is the exclusive property of NotaZip. Financial data entered by you remains your property.
terms.s7_text: NotaZip is not responsible for financial decisions made based on information displayed on the platform. The service is provided "as is", without guarantees of uninterrupted availability or absolute accuracy in OCR and AI processing.
terms.s8_text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Significant changes will be communicated by email or in-app notification. Continued use after modifications constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms.s9_text: For questions about these Terms of Use, contact us by email: suporte@notazip.com.br
